typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteName as string,
		ID as string,
		Name as string,
		Assignee as string,
		Discovered as string,
		Created as string,
		Occurred as date,
		Description as string,
		Reporter as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(uploaddate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName,
		Qty = iif((isNull(ID) || length(trim(ID)) == 0 || (upper(trim(ID)) == 'NULL')), 0, 1),
		OccurredMediaIncident = toString(year(Occurred)) + '-' + right('0' + toString(month(Occurred)), 2) + '-' + right('0' + toString(notConvertedectfunctiondateday(Occurred)), 2)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Description_MediaIncident as string,
		QtyMediaIncident as integer,
		SiteName_MediaIncident as string,
		Occurred_MediaIncident as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Description_MediaIncident = Description,
		QtyMediaIncident = Qty,
		SiteName_MediaIncident = SiteName,
		Occurred_MediaIncident = OccurredMediaIncident),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
